title: Valid Triangle Number
goal: Count index triples whose lengths form a nondegenerate triangle.
strategy: Sort side lengths. For a fixed largest side, one successful pair proves a whole interval of starts is valid.

phasePurposes.inspect: Sort side lengths. For a fixed largest side, one successful pair proves a whole interval of starts is valid.
phasePurposes.update: Every counted triple has a smallest pair whose sum exceeds its largest side.
phasePurposes.done: Every counted triple has a smallest pair whose sum exceeds its largest side.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
